summary: Daemon connects to hardcoded WebSocket gateway that can drive command execution on the host
details: The package's main entry and bin daemon open a hardcoded WebSocket connection to wss://memory.whalent.com/pt and process messages from that gateway as remote commands (including an `upgrade` action that resolves to package install/exec). The distribution bundles a full remote-terminal stack alongside the client — node-pty, @xterm/headless, ssh2, and a terminal-helper binary — giving the gateway operator a path to run shell/terminal commands on the machine running the daemon. Both dist/index.cjs and the 5.3 MB dist/core.cjs are additionally processed with javascript-obfuscator (string-array + rotator + hex identifier renaming, with javascript-obfuscator listed in devDependencies), which hides the exact contract of the remote-command handler that ingests messages from the gateway.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
